title: Require Domain Test Source Topology
forbids: domain test trees containing non-test source outside an explicit fixture owner or directories outside the recursive semantic hierarchy
why: Domain tests mirror behavioral ownership: domain-wide claims may remain at the domain root, while module and operation behavior descends through semantic directories. The structure law closes the physical test kind without guessing which production module a directory represents; that membership remains a semantic review decision until Habitat owns first-class blueprint membership.
remediate: Keep domain-wide *.test.ts files at the domain root, place narrower tests under kebab-case module and concern directories, and keep non-test helpers only in the nearest fixtures directory. Do not add source-to-test allowlists or execution-shaped operations, runtime, support, or testing cabinets.
message: Domain test source must match the positive domain, semantic-container, and fixture topology.
